### 1 — Scene
A breakfast tray: dry muesli, two small fruit portions, peach–passion-fruit yogurt, coffee, and a small bottle of milk. I include these tray items, but not objects outside the tray.

### 2 — Vessels
Estimated dimensions and areas:
- Cereal bowl: **18 cm diameter**, area **254 cm²**.
- Two fruit dishes: **9 cm diameter each**, area **64 cm² each**.
- Yogurt cup: approximately **7.5 cm diameter**, area **44 cm²**.
- Coffee mug: approximately **7.5 cm internal diameter**, area **44 cm²**.
- Milk bottle: approximately **6 cm internal diameter**, area **28 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible muesli components are oat flakes, nuts, seeds, and dried fruit. The side dishes contain orange/yellow fruit pieces and strawberries. Also present are packaged fruit yogurt, coffee, and milk. No added oil, dressing, or sugar is visible. The yogurt contents are concealed, so that estimate is less certain.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Heights are average occupied depths; the yogurt depth allows for the cup’s taper.

| Item | Area covered | Average height | Gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Oat flakes | 27% of cereal bowl | 1.3 cm | 89 ml | 0.35 | 31 g | 380 | 118 kcal |
| Nuts | 5% | 1.3 cm | 17 ml | 0.60 | 10 g | 610 | 61 kcal |
| Seeds | 4% | 1.3 cm | 13 ml | 0.55 | 7 g | 570 | 40 kcal |
| Dried fruit | 4% | 1.3 cm | 13 ml | 0.65 | 9 g | 300 | 27 kcal |
| Orange/yellow fruit pieces | 50% of fruit dish | 1.7 cm | 54 ml | 0.65 | 35 g | 50 | 18 kcal |
| Strawberries | 65% of fruit dish | 1.7 cm | 71 ml | 0.60 | 42 g | 32 | 13 kcal |
| Peach–passion-fruit yogurt | 100% of cup interior | 3.4 cm | 150 ml | 1.00 | 150 g | 95 | 143 kcal |
| Coffee | 100% of mug interior | 5.7 cm | 251 ml | 1.00 | 250 g | 1 | 3 kcal |
| Milk | 100% of bottle cross-section | 3.9 cm | 110 ml | 1.03 | 113 g | 62 | 70 kcal |

**Coverage check:** the cereal components total **40%** of the bowl area, consistent with the central pile and broad empty rim. The fruit portions cover approximately **50% and 65%** of their respective dishes.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **57 g of dry muesli** and **77 g of fruit** look plausible for the visible portions. Estimated total is **747 g and 493 kcal**, including drinks; excluding coffee and milk, approximately **384 g and 420 kcal**. Yogurt quantity and liquid depths are the largest uncertainties.
